description: Today, Michael Whatley toured Alliance One’s tobacco processing facility in Wilson alongside company leadership and tobacco farmers from the area. They discussed Roy Cooper’s record of raising costs on family farms and how Cooper’s agenda made it harder for farmers to make ends meet. Under Cooper’s watch, input costs went up, energy prices increased by 30%, all while he vetoed farm bills hurting family farms.

title: Michael Whatley Tours Tobacco Processing Facility in Wilson – Michael Whatley for Senate
